question: Why does Proxmox through the lab edge show 401 No ticket and empty Datacenter after login?
evidence: POST /api2/json/access/ticket through http://swarm1.lab.auzietek.com:8081 returned a valid ticket
GET /api2/json/cluster/resources without PVEAuthCookie returned 401 No ticket
GET /api2/json/cluster/resources with PVEAuthCookie returned VM201 and VM202
Proxmox proxmoxlib.js set PVEAuthCookie with secure=true even though the edge URL was HTTP
decision: Serve a patched proxmoxlib.js from lab-edge 8081 that only marks the cookie secure when the browser URL is HTTPS.
result: Browser Proxmox UI through 8081 can retain its ticket and show inventory after hard refresh.

question: Why did 30 VIDEO fail migrating VM132 from old Proxmox .9 after BKC was repointed to new .41?
evidence: .41 accepted root/changeme123 and had fresh Proxmox after 20 VIDEO
workspace root key could access .9 and list VM132 source inventory
authorizing BKC public key on .9 let BKC SSH as root without password
blank proxmox_source_password must mean key auth and must not fall back to global Proxmox config
decision: Make 30 source auth key-based by default, leave target auth explicit, and keep global Proxmox integration for the current target after validation.
